limitations: Acceptance is scoped to candidate02 executable content and the recorded isolated-schema rehearsals. Corrected package instructions do not represent another deployment, and v2 remains unpromoted.
Both routes ran on an existing temporary ADB Serverless database. Provisioning a new database or enabling/restarting JAVAVM was not tested by these rehearsals.
Each route used one app account for its browser rehearsal; this does not establish two-account browser isolation or permanent-delete confirmation.

Legacy sample conversations remain browser-session-bound and are not automatically converted into personal My Contexts work. Preserved v1 rows/evidence/RDF do not promise legacy chat reopening after logout.

New personal-answer database hashes were first recorded after adoption/follow-up. UI text and historical sources were compared before/after refinement; no pre-adoption database-hash comparison is claimed.
Final post-browser legacy model preservation covers three original model rowsets. Full twenty-table and six-graph comparisons were made earlier, before the new personal browser writes.
Historical dev validation records retain their own recorded scope. Generation/local tests alone do not establish native or browser acceptance.
